items.claim: Clock: every owed step runs in one frame, with no cap
items.note: `docs/unruled.md` already rules this "left as is", and its docs say to declare such a clock `seekable: false`.

items.claim: A non-finite `fx`/`fy` pin writes NaN into `x`/`y`
items.note: This needed a behavior call, so I made one: the node keeps its current position on that axis with zero velocity, rather than resetting to 0 like the free path does. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` and in the `fx` doc comment.
